title: Painting
body:
"Allows you to input a custom image id and display whatever your heart desires, please note that each stud is equal to 100 pixels!"

Description

The Painting is a decoration which can be purchased from Illumine Designs for $1,600. The painting can be resized and filled with a material to occupy the frame. Once it is filled in, an image in a image pool is selected and put on the painting. The player also has the option to open a prompt which requests a image ID to be inputted.
